nodes.label: I'd like you to help me think this through.

statements.quote: We need fewer leaking caps reaching dispatch: the current reject-and-return measure is 4.8% of bottles, and I want it below 3% by the end of the next 16 weeks.
statements.source: Please help me put a proper case around the camera inspection station I've been pushing for on our bottle-filling line. We need fewer leaking caps reaching dispatch: the current reject-and-return measure is 4.8% of bottles, and I want it below 3% by the end of the next 16 weeks. I manage production; Dev, our maintenance lead, says the capper drifts after a long run, but the vendor says its camera can spot bad cap alignment before packing. That's why I favour it. Operators already do spot checks and are stretched when we change bottle sizes. Finance has allowed £60,000 for the project, although nobody has signed an order. I'd put the camera after capping and use the existing reject gate. My concern is that we will call this solved because we reject more bottles inside the factory while the sealing problem carries on. I haven't developed another plan; I'd like you to help me think this through.

brief_text: Please help me put a proper case around the camera inspection station I've been pushing for on our bottle-filling line. We need fewer leaking caps reaching dispatch: the current reject-and-return measure is 4.8% of bottles, and I want it below 3% by the end of the next 16 weeks. I manage production; Dev, our maintenance lead, says the capper drifts after a long run, but the vendor says its camera can spot bad cap alignment before packing. That's why I favour it. Operators already do spot checks and are stretched when we change bottle sizes. Finance has allowed £60,000 for the project, although nobody has signed an order. I'd put the camera after capping and use the existing reject gate. My concern is that we will call this solved because we reject more bottles inside the factory while the sealing problem carries on. I haven't developed another plan; I'd like you to help me think this through.
message: The 4.8% combines internal rejects and customer returns, so I was wrong to describe it as leaks reaching dispatch. We don't have a reliable baseline for escaped leaks. Keep the below-3% target for the combined measure, but flag that I also care about escaped leaks and haven't set their target.
